## UC01 — Evaluate VERITRAIL from the website

**Actors:** Prospective buyer

**Goal:** Understand the framework, solutions and position on compliance claims.

**Preconditions:** None — public pages.

**Main flow:**

1. Open the home page; read the problem, six layers and five pillars.
2. Follow a pillar or solution card to its page; use "On this page" to jump to sections.
3. Hover or tap underlined terms for definitions; open a cited control.
4. Read the compliance guide and its disclaimer.

**Alternatives:**

- Use search (⌘K or "/") to jump straight to a topic.
- Open Appearance to read in another theme, mode or font.

**Outcome:** The visitor knows what VERITRAIL does and does not claim.

**Stories:** [S01.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s011) (E01), [S01.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s012) (E01), [S01.3](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s013) (E01), [S01.4](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s014) (E01), [S15.3](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s153) (E15), [S15.4](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s154) (E15), [S15.6](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s156) (E15)

**Capabilities:** CAP-001 Home page, CAP-002 Website content pages, CAP-005 Glossary, CAP-072 Site-wide search, CAP-073 Glossary definitions in text, CAP-074 Reading aids, CAP-077 Appearance — themes and fonts

## UC02 — Run the maturity self-assessment

**Actors:** AI governance lead

**Goal:** Get an indicative maturity baseline and a 30/60/90-day plan.

**Preconditions:** None.

**Main flow:**

1. Enter the organisation profile.
2. Answer 24 questions over eight domains.
3. Review the free preliminary result (score, level, domain bars).
4. Submit name, business email and organisation with consent to unlock the detailed report.
5. Download the report as Markdown or PDF.

**Alternatives:**

- Free-mail address — refused with a request for a business email.
- Service unreachable — report shown with a notice that nothing was saved or emailed.

**Outcome:** A User-asserted report; an assessment lead with qualification tags (no raw answers).

**Stories:** [S03.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s031) (E03), [S03.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s032) (E03), [S04.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s042) (E04)

**Capabilities:** CAP-010 Maturity self-assessment, CAP-020 Lead forms, CAP-067 Admin console

## UC03 — Triage an AI use case

**Actors:** AI system owner

**Goal:** Get a suggested risk tier and the review path.

**Preconditions:** None.

**Main flow:**

1. Describe the use case and answer the intake.
2. Review tier, factor points, triggers and missing facts.
3. Note the approval authority and review cadence.

**Alternatives:**

- Prohibited-practice keywords — Prohibited-review, "stop and get legal review".

**Outcome:** An Inferred tier that an approver must confirm.

**Stories:** [S03.3](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s033) (E03)

**Capabilities:** CAP-011 Risk triage

## UC04 — Draft runtime guardrails for an LLM app or agent

**Actors:** CISO / security architect, Engineering / platform lead

**Goal:** Produce a draft policy-as-code and permission matrix.

**Preconditions:** None.

**Main flow:**

1. Describe the application, tools, data and autonomy.
2. Review the rating, permission matrix, approval rules and limits.
3. Download the draft policy and advisor report.

**Outcome:** A draft policy in Observe mode, ready for engineering review and testing in the simulator.

**Stories:** [S03.4](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s034) (E03), [S13.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s132) (E13)

**Capabilities:** CAP-012 Guardrail generator, CAP-062 Runtime policy simulator

## UC05 — Ask a governance question

**Actors:** Prospective buyer, Consultant / advisor

**Goal:** Get a cited answer.

**Preconditions:** None.

**Main flow:**

1. Ask a question or choose a suggestion.
2. Read the answer and follow cited controls.

**Alternatives:**

- Unsafe request (injection, approval bypass, compliance determination) — refused with the reason.

**Outcome:** A deterministic, cited answer with no data sent anywhere.

**Stories:** [S03.5](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s035) (E03)

**Capabilities:** CAP-013 Ask VERITRAIL

## UC06 — Book a Governance Baseline or request a demo

**Actors:** Prospective buyer, Site administrator

**Goal:** Start a commercial conversation.

**Preconditions:** None.

**Main flow:**

1. Open the booking or demo page and complete the form with a business email and consent.
2. The submission is stored; if configured, it is pushed to the CRM.
3. An administrator reviews it in the admin console.

**Alternatives:**

- Network failure — the form says nothing was recorded.

**Outcome:** A stored lead visible to administrators.

**Stories:** [S04.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s041) (E04), [S04.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s042) (E04), [S14.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s141) (E14)

**Capabilities:** CAP-020 Lead forms, CAP-067 Admin console

## UC07 — Look up a control or a term

**Actors:** Internal auditor / assessor, AI governance lead

**Goal:** Find a control's evidence and mappings, or a definition.

**Preconditions:** None.

**Main flow:**

1. Press ⌘K and type a control ID (IS-11) or a term (kill switch).
2. Open the control page or glossary entry.

**Outcome:** The reader has the control's evidence examples and mappings, or the definition and related controls.

**Stories:** [S02.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s021) (E02), [S02.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s022) (E02), [S15.3](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s153) (E15), [S15.4](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s154) (E15)

**Capabilities:** CAP-003 Control library, CAP-004 Control detail, CAP-005 Glossary, CAP-072 Site-wide search, CAP-073 Glossary definitions in text

## UC08 — Install VERITRAIL and read offline

**Actors:** Prospective buyer, AI governance lead

**Goal:** Use VERITRAIL as an app, including without a connection.

**Preconditions:** The published HTTPS site.

**Main flow:**

1. Read two pages; accept the install card or use the header button.
2. Follow the browser dialog or the step-by-step instructions.
3. Launch from the home screen; use a shortcut.
4. Go offline and reopen pages read earlier.

**Outcome:** An installed app with offline reading of visited pages.

**Stories:** [S15.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s151) (E15), [S15.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s152) (E15)

**Capabilities:** CAP-070 Installable app (PWA), CAP-071 Offline reading

## UC09 — Assess the workspace with TILLER

**Actors:** AI governance lead

**Goal:** Score the 12 controls with evidence.

**Preconditions:** Demo workspace or signed in for a private one.

**Main flow:**

1. Step through each control; set the score and evidence status; add a URL or note.
2. Read the guidance and rubric where needed.
3. Finish and view the release gate.

**Outcome:** Pillar scores and the VERITRAIL Index reflect evidenced practice.

**Stories:** [S05.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s051) (E05), [S05.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s052) (E05)

**Capabilities:** CAP-030 Governance overview, CAP-031 TILLER assessment

## UC10 — Check release readiness and plan remediation

**Actors:** Approver, AI governance lead

**Goal:** Decide whether the workspace can release at its tier.

**Preconditions:** An assessment.

**Main flow:**

1. Open release readiness; read the gate status and pillar floors.
2. Open blocking controls; choose "Create remediation plan".
3. Track the items on the roadmap and the lifecycle checklist.

**Outcome:** Blockers become owned roadmap items.

**Stories:** [S05.3](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s053) (E05), [S09.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s091) (E09), [S09.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s092) (E09)

**Capabilities:** CAP-032 Release readiness, CAP-034 Roadmap, CAP-035 Lifecycle checklist

## UC11 — Register an AI system

**Actors:** AI system owner, AI governance lead

**Goal:** Add a system to the inventory with a triage.

**Preconditions:** None.

**Main flow:**

1. Open "Register & triage"; enter details and the triage answers.
2. Review the live result and save.
3. The record stays Under review until a human confirms it.

**Outcome:** An owned, classified inventory record with its rationale.

**Stories:** [S06.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s061) (E06), [S06.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s062) (E06)

**Capabilities:** CAP-036 AI inventory and triage

## UC12 — Configure guardrails by tier

**Actors:** CISO / security architect

**Goal:** Close runtime control gaps.

**Preconditions:** None.

**Main flow:**

1. Choose the workspace tier.
2. Switch on required guardrails; watch coverage.

**Outcome:** Coverage of required guardrails at the chosen tier.

**Stories:** [S07.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s071) (E07)

**Capabilities:** CAP-033 Guardrails designer

## UC13 — Handle an AI incident

**Actors:** AI system owner, AI governance lead

**Goal:** Triage, contain and close an incident with history.

**Preconditions:** None.

**Main flow:**

1. Log the incident with severity, category, system and owner.
2. Move it through Triage, Contained, Resolved and Closed; record response notes.
3. Raise a corrective action if needed.

**Outcome:** A closed incident with a full status history.

**Stories:** [S08.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s081) (E08), [S08.5](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s085) (E08)

**Capabilities:** CAP-037 Incidents and near misses, CAP-041 Corrective actions

## UC14 — Record a governance decision

**Actors:** Approver

**Goal:** Approve, conditionally approve, accept risk, reject, pause or retire a system.

**Preconditions:** A registered system.

**Main flow:**

1. Choose the system and disposition; enter rationale, conditions and review-by date.
2. Save; the previous decision is superseded.
3. If a record was entered wrongly, correct it with a reason; if it was made in error, withdraw it with a reason. The original stays in the register either way.

**Outcome:** A current decision with a review date, and a register that keeps every earlier record.

**Stories:** [S08.2](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s082) (E08)

**Capabilities:** CAP-038 Governance decisions

## UC15 — Review a material change

**Actors:** AI system owner, Approver

**Goal:** Screen a change before it ships.

**Preconditions:** A registered system.

**Main flow:**

1. Submit the change with categories and impact ratings.
2. The reviewer records the outcome; High or Critical impacts escalate.

**Outcome:** An approved, rejected or implemented change with the reviewer's note.

**Stories:** [S08.3](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s083) (E08)

**Capabilities:** CAP-039 Change reviews

## UC16 — Monitor a system and act on a breach

**Actors:** Engineering / platform lead, AI system owner

**Goal:** Keep thresholds under review.

**Preconditions:** A registered system.

**Main flow:**

1. Define a plan with metric, threshold, direction and cadence.
2. Record observations; a crossing shows Breach.
3. Follow the link to log an incident.

**Outcome:** Monitoring evidence and incident follow-up.

**Stories:** [S08.4](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s084) (E08), [S08.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s081) (E08)

**Capabilities:** CAP-037 Incidents and near misses, CAP-040 Monitoring

## UC17 — Close a corrective action with verification

**Actors:** AI system owner, Approver

**Goal:** Prove a fix works.

**Preconditions:** An action.

**Main flow:**

1. Start work; submit for verification with evidence.
2. The verifier closes it as effective, or returns it to work.

**Outcome:** A closed action with who verified and when.

**Stories:** [S08.5](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s085) (E08)

**Capabilities:** CAP-041 Corrective actions

**Goal:** Share the workspace position in a document.

**Main flow:**

1. Choose the pack and format; generate; download.

**Outcome:** A labelled preview document with blank sign-off.

## UC19 — Sign in and save a workspace

**Actors:** AI governance lead

**Goal:** Keep a private workspace.

**Preconditions:** An account.

**Main flow:**

1. Sign in; the demo state is cleared and the saved workspace loads.
2. Work; choose Save on the More screen.

**Alternatives:**

**Outcome:** A saved snapshot scoped to the user's organisation.

## UC20 — Turn a concern into actions with the advisor

**Actors:** AI governance lead

**Goal:** Map a concern to controls and tracked actions.

**Preconditions:** The AI gateway is configured.

**Main flow:**

1. Choose a focus and describe the concern.
2. Review mapped controls and actions; add them as corrective actions.

**Outcome:** New corrective actions with due dates.

**Stories:** [S10.6](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s106) (E10), [S08.5](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s085) (E08)

**Capabilities:** CAP-041 Corrective actions, CAP-047 AI governance advisor

## UC21 — Use the Agent console with approvals

**Actors:** AI governance lead, Approver

**Goal:** Run governed assistance with separation of duties.

**Preconditions:** None — synthetic data.

**Main flow:**

1. Choose a chat identity and an approving identity.
2. Assess a use case; generate the gap register and report.
3. Approve or reject requests; verify the audit chain.

**Outcome:** Reports and an audit log demonstrating approvals and refusals.

**Stories:** [S13.1](EPICS_AND_STORIES.md#s131) (E13)

**Capabilities:** CAP-061 VERITRAIL Agent console

## UC22 — Simulate runtime policy

**Actors:** Engineering / platform lead, CISO / security architect

**Goal:** See how a policy decides before deployment.

**Preconditions:** None.

1. Choose a policy pack or paste a policy; set the rollout mode.

**Actors:** Consultant / advisor, Chief Risk / Compliance Officer

**Goal:** Show the method end to end and its business case.

1. Run the pilot rehearsal and download its outputs.

**Outcome:** Rehearsal artefacts and an ROI estimate with labelled hypotheses.

## UC24 — Review leads and the funnel

**Actors:** Site administrator

**Goal:** Follow up leads and understand conversion.
